name: Dreary Village
desc1: This appears to be a small town nestled in the centre of the valley.
desc2: It presents a disheartening sight, even vaguely disturbing, as it is
desc3: constructed largely of grey stone and charcoal-coloured wood. Torches
desc4: set in the sides of the buildings provide the only light. To the west,
desc5: a large stone wall stands, broken only by an iron gate. A wide path
desc6: leads off to the east, with smaller ones to the north and south. There
desc7: is a vague sense of watchfulness here, and evil.
